exercises.q: What does до- add in доходи́ть (“to come to, to arrive at, to reach (usually by foot)”)?
options: fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
adding to what there was before
completing an action, reaching a goal
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists доходи́ть under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).

**доходит** — доходи́ть (imperfective): to come to, to arrive at, to reach (usually by foot); (by extension) to finally or eventually get to, to achieve some state or condition; (impersonal, colloquial) to become understood (by someone) (e.g. about a joke or fraud); to come down to. Wiktionary: до- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does до- add in доста́ть (“to reach, to touch”)?
options: fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
completing an action, reaching a goal
adding to what there was before
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists доста́ть under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).

**достал** — доста́ть (perfective): to reach, to touch; to take, to go fetch, to take out; to get, to procure, to obtain; especially about a product that is rare, or of which there is a shortage; (colloquial) to annoy someone badly. Wiktionary: до- + стать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach
to come to, to arrive at, to reach (usually by foot)
to run (to; as far as), to reach
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: дойти́ — to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach; доходи́ть — to come to, to arrive at, to reach (usually by foot); добежа́ть — to run (to; as far as), to reach; добра́ться — to get (to), to reach.

**достал** — доста́ть (perfective): to reach, to touch; to take, to go fetch, to take out; to get, to procure, to obtain; especially about a product that is rare, or of which there is a shortage; (colloquial) to annoy someone badly. Wiktionary: до- + стать.
